product_name_specific: KTM 125 SX ; KTM 150 SX ; KTM 125 XC (US Modell); HQV TC 125 ; GG MC 125
risk_description: A faulty ignition control unit may lead to the connecting rod in the cranktrain of the engine to break. This may cause the rear wheel to block, which in turn can lead to an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two or three wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
